title: Markov selection of a good parameter in an interval
statement: Let g : ℝ → [0, ∞] be almost-everywhere measurable for Lebesgue measure, p a predicate on ℝ that holds for Lebesgue-almost every t, a < b real numbers and I ∈ [0, ∞] with ∫_{(a,b)} g dL¹ ≤ I (lower Lebesgue integral over Ioo a b). Then there is t ∈ (a, b) with p(t) and (b − a)·g(t) ≤ 2·I, computed in [0, ∞] with b − a embedded by ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ → Prop) (a b : ℝ) (I : ℝ≥0∞), a < b → AEMeasurable g → (∀ᵐ t, p t) → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ I → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, p t ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) * g t ≤ 2 * I
